What to record: Identify room, cabinet, assembly ID, and released revision.
Record the person responsible and assembly date or shift.
List the parts and material group entering the operation.
State the face, edge, datum, drawing note, or tolerance used.
Example: Front edges flush / diagonals within 1 mm

What to record: Record drawer ID, cabinet opening, slide model, and target clearance.
Record side, front, back, bottom IDs and actual bottom/groove fit.
Record width, length, diagonals, twist, and fastener or joint result.
Record installed clearance, travel, latch, load test, and adjustment.
Example: 12.7 mm each side / full travel pass
